newsitem.title: USA: Quick & Reilly buys OTC market maker.
newsitem.headline: Quick & Reilly buys OTC market maker.

text.p: The Quick & Reilly Group Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Nash, Weiss & Co, a U.S. market maker in Nasdaq-listed stocks.
Nash, Weiss' revenues total about $60 million a year.
Financial terms were not made disclosed.

The acquisition gives Quick & Reilly an outlet in the over-the-counter market. Best known for its retail brokerage business, Quick & Reilly also owns the second largest specialist firm, or market-making firm, on the New York Stock Exchange.
"We expect to provide the resources that enable Nash, Weiss to capture a greater share of the NASDAQ market," Quick chief executive Leslie Quick said in a news release.
